notes.title: Free Music Update on Sept 24 — Shirobon + Future Funk Squad
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]On September 24th I'll be updating all versions of Beat Hazard to include some great new tracks.[/p][p][/p][p]First we have 5 amazing chip-tune tracks from [url="https://open.spotify.com/artist/2OgP0RGmDrXN9kOWRNfEuE"]Shirobon[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I've also been working with [url="https://open.spotify.com/artist/3zU9fuxpRmXdJk7nyTe8u9"]Future Funk Squad[/url] who have worked with Nine Inch Nails, Sia and U2. They have made an exclusive track for Beat Hazard, and I'm really excited for everyone to play it. I'm so privileged to be able to work with a top flight artist![/p][p][/p][p]On Sept 24th, Beat Hazard returns to PlayStation. Details [url="https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10011890"]here[/url] 
[/p][p]I'm gaging interest on a Steam release of Beat Hazard Arcade. It would have full VR support, and be a streamlined Arcade Beat Hazard experience. It would have some new weapons and enemies, and focus on community leaderboards. I'm interested to hear some feedback. [/p][p]
Happy Hazarding![/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Steve.[/p]

notes.title: 14th Birthday update!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Here's the 14th Birthday update for all 3 Beat Hazard games.

You can now play all the OST music in each of the games.

There's also an awesome 1 hour long remix by Johnny Frizz. (Who will be first to finish it?) 

Join me for an AMA on reddit here:
https://www.reddit.com/r/pcgaming/comments/1bxf915/ama_im_steve_solo_indie_dev_of_beat_hazard_bh_is/

And check out the cool video of Johnny crating the remix:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tc8bbpZjwyY

Thank you so much for all the support all these years, I love you all!

I hope you enjoy the update. Here's to the next 14 years! (What would you like to see?)

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: BH3 - Phase 3: Ancient Aliens update now live.
notes.notes:
Hi all,
The Beat Hazard 3 - Phase 3: Ancient Aliens update is now live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/1409629/b236cf1b242dc2db779bdae7df72f292166667f7.png[/img]

New additions include:

- Alien Blueprints: A new currency used to unlock new tech and weapons
- Galaxy Scan System: Used for finding new tech and resources in a galaxy
- New Dracarys Weapon: An intense wall of fire used to destroy ships, photons & shields.
- Crusader Auto Turret II: A new version of the auto turret weapon
- New Ship Tuning: Replaces the BH2 Modules system. Includes a number of new attributes.

Here is a YouTube video where I fully explain all the new features:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fAU4tJx4_Zw

Cheers,
Steve.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493520/Beat_Hazard_3/

notes.title: BH3 Phase 2 Update.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I'd like to share a major update for BH3:

Welcome to the Phase 2 update: Lock & Load.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/1409629/af12b30e636b1e2cf2b98300f18169d63ae8b2bc.png[/img]

The Phase 2 update includes a brand new system to upgrade, configure and overdrive your weapons.

Features include:
- Complete tracks to collect 'Alien Nano Tech' to upgrade weapons
- Experiment with different configurations that suit your play style
- Overdrive weapon attributes to massively boost performance

- Survival mode rework. How long can you survive with ever increasing difficulty?

Here is a detailed walk through of the next update:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O-cPNfXRWJs

Work is still ongoing with this update. No doubt there will be some bugs to fix and game play elements to balance.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493520/Beat_Hazard_3/

Cheers,
Steve.

- Added 'Ship Hangar' on the main menu. Change your ship type here
- Added separate leader boards for Standard, Gold, Mini Gold & Dragon ships. (Access these from the Ship Hangar)
- Added 'change ship' option to the online lobby screen

Let me know if there's any problems.

* Added 'noWarningSound' preference command - Disables boss warning siren

Cheers,
Steve

notes.title: Beat Hazard Update
notes.notes:
Hi chaps,

A new update is out! This has local Co-op play and iTunes DLC. Check it out:


- Added iTunes/m4a/aac support via DLC (This is to cover the acc licensing costs)
- Added Two Player Mode: Co-Op. Cooperate with a friend to complete a track
- Added Two Player Mode: Head to Head. Gloves off! Who can get the highest score?
- Added Suicidal Difficulty

- Improved auto gain for quieter songs
- Added Preference file see here for details: http://forums.steampowered.com/forums/showthread.php?t=1276610
- Added Preference file command to turn off News Feed
- Added Preference file command to keep music volume at a constant level
- Added Preference file command to allow custom screen resolutions
- Added AZERTY key mappings
- 'Space' or 'Xbox X' now skips a track in Chill Out Mode

- Fixed preview play for folders with +50 tracks
- Fixed mouse limit problem
- Fixed Superbomb fired on button press (not button release)

Enjoy,
Cheers,
Steve

    - Dutch

Cheers,
Steve
